comp-mp5rpco1.html: Advanced technology project for autonomous mobility

comp-l667rgun1.html:
REX was developed as an R&D technology project focused on autonomous mobile robot navigation. The system explored AI-driven fleet management, multi-sensor data fusion and machine vision for flexible movement and control of autonomous mobile robots.

​

The project reflects DataVision’s expertise in AI-driven automation, computer vision and complex system integration - capabilities that also support our broader work in visual data processing, image and video analysis, and smart workflow automation.

comp-l667iv2y2.html: REX AI combines fleet management, map intelligence, planning and real-time monitoring into one software layer for autonomous mobile robot operations. It helps coordinate robot movement, optimize routes and provide live visibility across the fleet.
